candidate.description: PROC-300 (Company Reconnaissance) PROCESS.md — validated against the executable-process invariant set (10 comparators across 24 layers) and Grid Reader structural requirements.
candidate.scope: factory/outreach/300-blog-worker/PROCESS.md as the primary artifact. heir.yaml and src/ as supporting boundary files. Validation target: US run-003 invariant set for medium 'executable-process'.

elements.description: The PROCESS.md exists as a single parseable document with three structural clusters: Identity (§1-§2), Contract (§3-§6), Governance (§7-§14). Maps to L1.
elements.format: Markdown document with numbered section headers. Three clusters mapped to Thing/Flow/Change.

elements.description: §1 Identity table + heir.yaml HEIR fields. 10 process fields (ID, Name, Business Silo, CTB Position, ORBT, Strikes, Last Deployed, BAR Reference, Deployed URL, Cron) + 8 HEIR fields in heir.yaml. Maps to L5.
elements.format: Markdown table (10 rows) + YAML file (8 fields). 18 total named fields.

elements.description: Directory name '300-blog-worker', heir.yaml name 'Blog Worker', PROCESS.md title 'Company Reconnaissance'. Three names for one process. Orchestrator flagged this.
elements.format: String mismatch across three files.

elements.description: §3 IMO section. Two-Question Intake answered (trigger + source). Middle table with 5 columns (Step, Input, What Happens, Output, Tool Used) across 5 rows. Output block names downstream consumers (200, 201, 202). Circle block present (--stale 90 feedback). Maps to L8.
elements.format: Two-Question Intake (2 answered questions) + Middle table (5 cols × 5 rows) + Output prose + Circle prose.

elements.description: §5 OSAM section. READ table (2 rows, 3 cols), WRITE table (7 rows, 3 cols), Join Chain (traces to outreach_id spine), Forbidden Paths (4 rows, 2 cols), Query Routing (5 rows, 3 cols). Maps to L9.
elements.format: Four sub-sections with markdown tables. Join chain in tree notation.

elements.description: DMJ content exists but is NOT labeled as canonical DMJ tables (Define/Map/Join). §6 C&V section has Constants table (8 rows with C_i, primitive, k_i) and Variables list — this IS the Define step content. §5 OSAM Join Chain IS Join step content. Map step (Source→Target→Transform) is implicit in the Middle table step mappings but not explicitly formatted as a 3-column Map table. Maps to L10.
elements.format: Expected: three ordered tables (Define 5-col, Map 3-col, Join 3-col). Found: Define-equivalent in §6 Constants table, Join-equivalent in §5 Join Chain, Map not in canonical format.

elements.description: §6 Constants & Variables section. Constants table (8 rows with comparator, primitive, tolerance). Variables bullet list (10 items). Mathematical definitions block present. Maps to L11.
elements.format: Two sub-sections: Constants table + Variables bullet list. Mathematical preamble with P(x;θ) definition.

elements.description: §7 Stop Conditions. 6 rows: CAPTCHA >10%, Error >5%, Cost >$100, Can't answer intake, D1 write failures >1%, Strike 3. All 6 canonical conditions present. Maps to L12.
elements.format: Table: 2 columns (Condition, Action). 6 rows.

elements.description: §9 Smoke Test. 5 numbered executable steps with expected output. Three Primitives Check present with all three questions (Thing, Flow, Change) answered. Maps to L13.
elements.format: Numbered code block (5 steps) + Three Primitives Check (3 binary questions).

elements.description: §10 Analytics section. Process Metrics table (12 comparators with C_i, primitive, unit, baseline, k_i, phase). Sigma Tracking table (5 metrics, Run 1 baseline, trend = BASELINE). ORBT Gate Rules table (4 transitions). All three sub-sections present. Maps to L14.
elements.format: Three sub-sections: Metrics table (12 rows, 7 cols), Sigma table (5 rows, 6 cols), ORBT table (4 rows, 3 cols).

elements.description: §11 Execution Trace. Run 1 summary table (10 fields) + trace entries table (9 rows with Step/Target/Actual/Delta/Status/Timestamp — 6 columns). Append-only constraint stated. Maps to L15.
elements.format: Run summary table + trace entries table. 6 columns present of 14 required (trace_id, run_id, error_code, error_message, tools_used, duration_ms, cost_cents, signed_by missing from per-step entries).

elements.description: §10 ORBT Gate Rule table. All 4 transitions defined: BUILD→OPERATE (3 runs + auditor), OPERATE→REPAIR (metric outside tolerance), REPAIR→OPERATE (fix + auditor), Any→TROUBLESHOOT/TRAIN (Strike 3). Maps to L24.
elements.format: Table: 3 columns (From, To, Gate). 4 rows.

elements.description: §12 Logbook. Birth Certificate table (8 fields) + Run 1 Entry table (12 fields). Append-only. Created after BUILD→OPERATE. Maps to L16.
elements.format: Two tables: Birth Certificate (8 rows), Run 1 Entry (12 rows). signed_by = 'Pending auditor certification'.

elements.description: §13 Fleet Failure Registry. Pattern Registry table (2 entries: FP-301, FP-302). Incident Details for each. Strike Rules (1→repair, 2→scrutiny, 3→T/T). Maps to L17.
elements.format: Registry table (8 cols) + incident narrative + strike rules list.

elements.description: §14 Session Log. 6 entries with Date, What Was Done, LBB Record. Append-only pointer to LBB knowledge store. Maps to L18.
elements.format: Table: 3 columns (Date, What Was Done, LBB Record). 6 rows.

elements.description: heir.yaml present with 8 fields: sovereign_ref, hub_id, ctb_placement, imo_topology, cc_layer, services, secrets_provider, acceptance_criteria.
elements.format: YAML file with 8 top-level keys.

elements.description: The entire PROCESS.md as a machine-parseable grid. All 14 sections use markdown tables or structured blocks. No prose-only sections blocking programmatic extraction.
elements.format: Markdown with consistent table structure per section. Headers map to section IDs.

elements.description: §3 Middle section contains per-step comparator tables (C_1 through C_12) with tolerances and P(x;θ) equations. This is beyond the invariant set requirement — the process self-instruments at the step level.
elements.format: Per-step comparator tables: 6 columns (C_i, Name, Primitive, Measures, Initial k_i, Phase). 5 step-level P equations.

elements.description: §2 Why This Exists. Names what breaks without it (200, 201, 202 start blind) and what downstream process starves. Maps to L6.
elements.format: Prose block: 2 sentences + 1 rule statement.

elements.description: §4 What It Grabs Off The Wall + §8 Dependencies. Databases table (1 row), Tools table (4 rows), Secrets table (2 rows), Upstream table (1 row), Downstream table (3 rows). Maps to L7.
elements.format: Five tables across two sections with distinct column schemas.

C_exists_deviation.measurement: Count of three required cluster headers (Identity/Contract/Governance) MISSING from PROCESS.md. 0 = all present.

C_identity_missing_fields.measurement: Count of 18 required identity fields (10 process + 8 HEIR) that are absent or empty. 0 = all present.

C_imo_gap_count.measurement: Count of IMO sub-component failures: (1) intake questions unanswered, (2) Middle table missing columns, (3) Output missing downstream consumer. Max possible = 3. 0 = fully compliant.

C_osam_gap_count.measurement: Count of OSAM sub-component failures: (1) READ table absent, (2) join chain missing spine ID, (3) forbidden paths section absent. Max possible = 3. 0 = fully compliant.

C_dmj_gap_count.measurement: Count of DMJ canonical format gaps: (1) Define table not in 5-col canonical format, (2) Map table not in 3-col Source/Target/Transform format, (3) Join path not in 3-col format. Max possible = 3. 0 = fully compliant.

C_guardrails_deficit.measurement: max(0, 6 - count_of_declared_stop_conditions). 0 = meets or exceeds 6 canonical conditions.

C_verification_gap_count.measurement: Count of verification failures: (1) no numbered steps, (2) steps missing expected results, (3) Three Primitives Check absent. Max possible = 3. 0 = fully compliant.

C_measurement_gap_count.measurement: Count of measurement sub-component failures: (1) metrics table absent or no metrics defined, (2) sigma tracking absent, (3) ORBT gate rules absent. Max possible = 3. 0 = fully compliant.

C_trace_missing_fields.measurement: Count of 14 required trace entry fields missing from the per-step schema. Fields present: step, target, actual, delta, status, timestamp (6). Missing: trace_id, run_id, error_code, error_message, tools_used, duration_ms, cost_cents, signed_by (8).

C_orbt_missing_transitions.measurement: Count of 4 required ORBT transitions (BUILD→OPERATE, OPERATE→REPAIR, REPAIR→OPERATE, Any→T/T) not defined with gate conditions. 0 = all present.

C_naming_inconsistency_count.measurement: Count of naming mismatches across PROCESS.md title, heir.yaml name, and directory name. 0 = all aligned.

C_grid_reader_opaque_sections.measurement: Count of sections that cannot be machine-parsed into structured key-value or tabular data. Requires a parser run against the markdown to evaluate.
C_grid_reader_opaque_sections.reason: No grid reader parser has been run against this document yet. Structural inspection suggests all 14 sections use tables or structured blocks, but programmatic verification is pending.
